questions.q: What belongs in your personal instructions?
options: Your account numbers, so it can help with banking
Short, general facts and preferences for most chats
A detailed essay covering your whole life story
Specific health details, so answers are personalized
questions.explain: Personal instructions should be short, general and free of sensitive details: who you are, what you use AI for and how you like your answers.

questions.q: You're starting a months-long home renovation and will ask AI about it often. What's the best setup?
options: A workspace, or a briefing note, with the project's background
Retyping the full background at the start of every new chat
Adding every renovation detail to your personal instructions
Running the entire project in one single, never-ending chat
questions.explain: Workspaces are for ongoing areas like a renovation. If your assistant has no workspace feature, a short briefing note you paste in works everywhere.

questions.q: You've used the same weekly-planning prompt three times this month. What does the lesson suggest?
options: Retype it from memory each time so it stays fresh
Paste the whole prompt into your personal instructions
Stop using it, because repeated prompts stop working
Save it with blanks to fill in your "My AI Prompts" note
questions.explain: Any prompt you use more than twice deserves to be saved as a template with blanks to fill in, in a note like "My AI Prompts".
